name: quarter
description: Reference quarter of the observation, from 1 to 4
observations: Derived from the ABS mid-quarter month: February is quarter 1, May is 2, August is 3 and November is 4.

name: month
description: Reference month of the observation, from 1 to 12
observations: The ABS mid-quarter month, always February, May, August or November.

name: geography
description: Geographic area: one of the eight Australian states and territories
observations: States and territories follow the ASGS (2011) state and territory structure. To be linked to br_bd_diretorios_au once that directory carries a state table.

name: industry_division_code
description: ANZSIC 2006 division letter, from A to S
observations: Not published in the cube: attached from the ANZSIC (2006) Rev.2.0 division list, asserted to cover every observed label. In employment_industry, where the cube publishes group-level codes, the division is derived from the group code's ANZSIC subdivision (its first two digits), and directly from the letter for the 19 division-level nfd residuals.
original_name: Industry division of main job: ANZSIC (2006) Rev.2.0

name: industry_division
description: ANZSIC 2006 division of the main job
observations: ANZSIC (2006) Rev.2.0, carried by ABS across the whole history of the cube. A dedicated ANZSIC directory does not exist yet in br_bd_diretorios_au and is future work.
original_name: Industry division of main job: ANZSIC (2006) Rev.2.0

name: industry_group_code
description: ANZSIC 2006 group code of the main job
observations: Split from the code-prefixed label ABS publishes. Stored as a string because the leading zero is significant. 272 of the 291 values are a real three-digit ANZSIC group code; the other 19 are the division-level not further defined residuals, which ABS codes as the division letter followed by 00, one per ANZSIC division.
original_name: Industry group of main job: ANZSIC (2006) Rev.2.0

name: industry_group
description: ANZSIC 2006 group of the main job
observations: ANZSIC (2006) Rev.2.0, carried by ABS across the whole history of the cube. A dedicated ANZSIC directory does not exist yet in br_bd_diretorios_au and is future work. The three-character code prefix ABS ships on the label is split out into industry_group_code. Labels ending in nfd are ABS not further defined residuals.
original_name: Industry group of main job: ANZSIC (2006) Rev.2.0

name: sex
observations: The Detailed cubes publish males and females only. A persons total is not derived by summing the two, because ABS benchmarks and rounds its estimates independently, so the sum is not the published total.

name: employed_full_time
observations: Converted from ABS thousands to absolute persons

name: employed_part_time
observations: Converted from ABS thousands to absolute persons

description: Total hours actually worked in all jobs by persons employed full-time
observations: Converted from ABS thousands of hours to hours
original_name: Number of hours actually worked in all jobs (employed full-time) ('000 Hours)

name: hours_worked_part_time
description: Total hours actually worked in all jobs by persons employed part-time
observations: Converted from ABS thousands of hours to hours
